name: Oryel
summary: Oryel showcases a chemical glass top backed in deep dark grey, giving the surface a sleek, tempered clarity with a modern, moody tone. The body is wrapped in light grey matte elm veneer, adding a soft, contemporary texture that balances the glass. Inside, melamine panels keep the storage clean and orderly. Brass metallic painted metal legs introduce a warm, refined contrast, completing the piece with a polished contemporary presence. Top with 5mm chemical glass top back in dark grey color , tempered , the body all cover with elm veneer in light gray matt inner panels with melamine, metal legs paint in brass metallic. 200x42x53
